name: Token Efficiency Engine
description: Help any AI complete tasks with minimal tokens — Blender and Unreal Engine adapters included
long_description:
TEE helps any AI optimize its token usage and improve its work efficiency. It is an MCP server between an AI model and the tools it drives — shipping with Blender and Unreal Engine adapters — whose core metric is tokens per completed task. Reads return compact summaries and diffs instead of scene dumps, mutations run as checkpointed batches, and the long tail of DCC capability is reached through progressive disclosure rather than hundreds of always-loaded tools.

Blender needs the TEE bridge extension (or the official Blender Lab MCP add-on); Unreal needs UE 5.8+ with Epic's ModelContextProtocol and AllToolsets plugins enabled. See the repository for setup.

tools.name: tee_status
tools.description: Server, adapter and scene status, with an optional compact project recap

tools.name: tee_recall
tools.description: Recall persistent project memory as a compact session preamble

tools.name: tee_remember
tools.description: Store durable project memory: facts by key and dated notes

tools.name: tee_scene_summary
tools.description: Compact, paged scene summary: entity counts and ids, filterable

tools.name: tee_entity_detail
tools.description: Full cached detail for one entity by id

tools.name: tee_diff
tools.description: What changed since a known (epoch, revision) stamp

tools.name: tee_batch
tools.description: Run a checkpointed batch of mutations in one call

tools.name: tee_rollback
tools.description: Roll the scene back to a checkpoint

tools.name: tee_job
tools.description: Start or poll long-running jobs outside the request lock

tools.name: tee_capture
tools.description: Budgeted viewport capture as inline JPEG

tools.name: tee_media
tools.description: Budgeted media handling for renders and references

tools.name: tee_script
tools.description: Run a budgeted mini-script of tool calls in the sandboxed interpreter

tools.name: tee_search_tools
tools.description: Progressively discover the long tail of DCC-specific virtual tools

tools.name: tee_describe_tool
tools.description: Inspect one virtual tool's full schema before calling it

tools.name: tee_call
tools.description: Invoke a discovered virtual tool by name

project_root.title: Project folder
project_root.description: Folder where TEE keeps per-project state (.tee/ memory, checkpoints, extract store). Pick your working project folder — not the extension directory, which is wiped on update.
